title: Delete Characters to Make Fancy String
description: Delete the minimum number of characters such that no three consecutive characters are equal.

steps.note: Initialize result array with first character.
Compare 'a' with last two characters in result. Adding new 'a'.
Compare 'a' with 'a' and 'a'. Condition fails, skip current 'a'.
Compare 'b' with 'a' and 'a'. Condition true, append 'b'.
